functional_requirements.title: Availability search
functional_requirements.description: Guests shall search room availability by property, arrival date, departure date, room type, occupancy, and accessibility needs.

functional_requirements.title: Reservation
functional_requirements.description: Guests and authorized front-desk staff shall create, view, modify, and cancel reservations according to the active cancellation policy.

functional_requirements.title: Check-in and check-out
functional_requirements.description: Front-desk staff shall check guests in and out, record the assigned room, and update the room occupancy state.

functional_requirements.title: Room inventory
functional_requirements.description: The platform shall prevent double booking by maintaining one authoritative inventory record for every room and date range.

functional_requirements.title: Housekeeping
functional_requirements.description: Housekeeping staff shall update each room as dirty, cleaning, inspected, maintenance blocked, or ready for occupancy.

functional_requirements.title: Payments
functional_requirements.description: The platform shall send payment authorization and refund requests to an approved external payment gateway without storing raw card numbers or card security codes.

functional_requirements.title: Invoices
functional_requirements.description: The platform shall generate an itemized invoice containing room charges, taxes, discounts, additional services, payments, and refunds.

functional_requirements.title: Rates and policies
functional_requirements.description: Authorized property managers shall manage room rates, taxes, seasonal restrictions, cancellation rules, and promotional codes.

functional_requirements.title: Notifications
functional_requirements.description: The platform shall send reservation confirmations, modifications, cancellations, check-in reminders, and payment receipts through approved email or SMS providers.

functional_requirements.title: Guest service
functional_requirements.description: Guests and staff shall create and track service requests such as extra towels, late check-out, maintenance, and accessibility assistance.

functional_requirements.title: Reports Property managers
functional_requirements.description: Reports Property managers shall view occupancy, revenue, cancellations, refunds, room status, and service-request reports for properties they are authorized to manage.

functional_requirements.title: Audit review
functional_requirements.description: Authorized security auditors shall search and export authentication, administrative, reservation, payment, and access-control audit events.

non_functional_requirements.title: Availability
non_functional_requirements.description: The guest reservation service shall provide 99.9 percent monthly availability, excluding approved maintenance windows.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance
non_functional_requirements.description: The 95th percentile response time for availability searches shall remain below 2 seconds under the agreed normal load.

non_functional_requirements.title: Concurrency
non_functional_requirements.description: The system shall support at least 500 simultaneous guest sessions and 100 simultaneous staff sessions without overselling room inventory.

non_functional_requirements.title: Recovery
non_functional_requirements.description: Production data protection shall support a recovery point objective of 15 minutes and a recovery time objective of 60 minutes.

non_functional_requirements.title: Observability
non_functional_requirements.description: Every production service shall expose health status, structured logs, metrics, correlation identifiers, and alerts for critical failures.

non_functional_requirements.title: Accessibility
non_functional_requirements.description: Guest-facing web pages shall support keyboard navigation, readable focus indicators, and accessible labels for form controls.

non_functional_requirements.title: Data residency
non_functional_requirements.description: Guest profile, reservation, and invoice data shall remain in the company-approved India hosting region, except data sent to approved third-party processors.

security_requirements.title: Transport security
security_requirements.description: All internet-facing and service-to-service communications shall use TLS 1.2 or higher with certificate validation.

security_requirements.title: Encryption at rest
security_requirements.description: Guest data, reservation data, invoices, backups, audit logs, and application secrets shall be encrypted at rest.

security_requirements.title: Staff authentication
security_requirements.description: Front-desk staff, managers, administrators, and security auditors shall use multi-factor authentication.

security_requirements.title: Authorization
security_requirements.description: The platform shall enforce role-based access control, property-level authorization, least privilege, and deny-by-default access.

security_requirements.title: Secrets
security_requirements.description: API credentials, database passwords, certificates, and encryption keys shall be stored in an approved secrets-management service and shall not be stored in source code.

security_requirements.title: Network boundaries
security_requirements.description: Public access, application services, restricted data stores, corporate administration, and third-party services shall be separated by explicit trust boundaries and network controls.

security_requirements.title: Audit protection
security_requirements.description: Security-relevant audit events shall be timestamped, linked to an actor or workload identity, protected from unauthorized modification, and retained for at least 365 days.

security_requirements.title: Application protection
security_requirements.description: Internet traffic shall pass through rate limiting and web-application attack protection, and critical vulnerabilities shall block production release.

security_requirements.title: Payment-data boundary
security_requirements.description: The company shall use a payment gateway tokenization flow so that raw payment-card data does not enter the motel platform trust boundary.

security_requirements.title: Privacy rights
security_requirements.description: The platform shall record privacy consent and support authorized access, correction, export, and deletion requests for guest personal data, subject to legal retention obligations.

security_requirements.title: Financial retention
security_requirements.description: Final invoices, tax records, refunds, and related audit evidence shall be retained for seven years and access shall be limited to authorized roles.
